newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs May index falls to 56.8.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs May index falls to 56.8.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer fell to a seasonally adjusted 56.8 in May from 57.2 in April, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Friday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index rose to 56.9 in May from 53.3 in April.
The employment component of the barometer fell to 53.6 in May from 56.1 in April.
(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said the prices paid component "continues to move in a narrow range," while production, new orders and order backlog "settle into the upper 50s."
Order backlogs are at the highest level since January 1995, it added, and inventories fell for the second consecutive month.
